categories.main_business_segments: Beijing Watertek Information Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in software and information technology services, focusing on embedded systems testing products and services, electronic component testing and reliability assurance, equipment health management, communication products, intelligent products, tax information technology, financial information security and service platforms, oil and gas industry informatization products and services, and new digital city construction including planning, implementation, and integrated intelligent management service platforms.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages embedded AI intelligent diagnostic tools, digital equipment predictive maintenance technologies, high-speed bus communication testing, system-level verification tools, and AI-driven algorithms. It develops products based on LTE and 5G+ self-organizing network technologies, deep learning-based voice enhancement, intelligent recognition algorithms, and integrates technologies such as IoT, cloud computing, big data, blockchain, and digital twin. Manufacturing includes automated testing equipment for integrated circuits and electronic components, with a focus on domestic production and reliability testing aligned with military standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include military research institutes, power industry, public security and emergency sectors, tax authorities, enterprises requiring tax control products and services, government departments, enterprises in new smart city construction, oil and gas companies, and financial institutions. The company serves both defense/military and civilian markets, with significant projects in digital city services, tax informatization, and smart infrastructure.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with business concentrated in North China, East China, and Southwest China regions, accounting for approximately 88.67% of revenue. It has subsidiaries and operations in Beijing, Shanghai, Xi'an, Chengdu, Ningxia, Hainan, and other provinces. It also has international investments and subsidiaries, including in Singapore.
categories.supply_chain_position: Beijing Watertek operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the software and information technology service supply chain, providing embedded system products, testing services, digital infrastructure solutions, and integrated intelligent management platforms. It acts as a solution provider and system integrator rather than a raw material supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company strategically focuses on AI, cloud computing, big data, IoT, and industry-specific AI applications, including AI chips, computing power, big data, and large model construction. It emphasizes innovation in embedded AI diagnostics, digital twin, predictive maintenance, and intelligent communication technologies. R&D efforts are concentrated on intelligent sensing, data processing, security, and digital city solutions, with collaborations involving universities and research institutions to foster advanced technology development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of embedded systems, digital city solutions, tax control products, and security products, as well as through providing integrated solutions and professional services. The company uses a direct sales model and offers SaaS platforms, licensing, and service contracts, including long-term maintenance and operation services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in embedded systems for both military and civilian sectors, with a strong market position in equipment health management, electronic component testing, and digital city services. It holds authoritative status as a third-party testing institution in military electronic components and has a comprehensive product and service portfolio. Competitors include other domestic and international software and embedded system providers, but the company emphasizes its integrated solutions and AI-driven innovation as competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 2.72 billion, a 9.23% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 274.5 million. The company’s assets totaled about RMB 5.83 billion at year-end. Despite recent losses, the company maintains a stable operational scale with ongoing investments in R&D (R&D expenses of RMB 181 million in 2024) and strategic business expansion, particularly in digital city and AI-related sectors.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through its deep expertise in embedded systems integrating AI and digital twin technologies, providing comprehensive lifecycle equipment health management and intelligent communication solutions. It offers highly customized, industry-specific digital transformation solutions, combining hardware and software with advanced AI capabilities. Its products emphasize reliability, security, and domestic innovation, supporting critical sectors like defense, emergency response, and smart city infrastructure, thereby delivering high-value, intelligent, and secure digital solutions.
